digest.component_or_area: test-only reliability oracles — subprocess and network sentinels
propositions: Two reliability oracle tests consume multi-second wall time per matrix cell due to production-scale real-time windows (10s low-speed window with 15s loopback server for snapshot test; 1s per-attempt deadline plus real 2s/4s retry sleeps for ACLI subprocess test).

The snapshot slow-progress test must retain a real loopback socket and above-floor byte pacing for more than one complete configured window without being misclassified as a stall, injecting a 1s test-only window instead.

The ACLI read-retry test must launch exactly _MAX_ATTEMPTS real child process sessions, observe the exact production retry schedule [2, 4] without sleeping through real intervals, and prove every spawned PID is absent after terminal failure via polling.
Production timeout, stall, grace, drain, attempt, and backoff defaults and constants must remain byte-unchanged.
Both focused test modules must pass with target tests completing in low single-digit seconds without brittle wall-clock assertions or runner/platform/version changes.
